chunks: Protect yourselves from the Fire, even if it is with half a date.

key_terms.النَّارَ: the Fire, meaning punishment in the Hereafter
key_terms.اِتَّقُوا: Guard yourselves; take protection through God-conscious action
key_terms.شِقِّ تَمْرَةٍ: half a date; a symbol of even the smallest charitable gift

ai.seo_question: How can even a small act of charity protect a person from the Fire?
ai.summary: This hadith urges believers to guard themselves from the Fire through acts of charity, even if what they give is very small. It highlights that modest deeds done sincerely can carry great spiritual weight and serve as protection in the Hereafter.
